question: Does the immediate multicoordinate motor collapse/recovery organization observed for sucrose shocks transport when osmolyte identity, phosphate-buffer cation context, or clockwise-lock/strain context changes?
whole_event: four shock strengths (200,300,400,500 mM) mapped to immediate motor collapse and post-removal recovery organization under four source-defined contexts

sucrose_MB_CCW.interpretation: reference; KAF95 CCW motors in motility buffer, sucrose shock

sorbitol_MB_CCW.interpretation: non-ionic osmolyte identity change; KAF95 CCW motors in motility buffer, sorbitol shock

sucrose_SPB_CCW.interpretation: buffer-cation context change; sucrose shocks in sodium phosphate buffer without potassium phosphate

sucrose_CW_lock.interpretation: clockwise-lock context using HCB1797 rather than KAF95; includes rotor-direction/conformation plus strain/plasmid background change and is not treated as a pure single-factor intervention

processing.normalization: each motor trace divided by its mean for time <= 180 s
processing.collapse_model: manuscript-facing constrained sigmoid with A_dec fixed from speed_initial-speed_final and tau_dec,t0_dec fit with positive bounds
processing.recovery_model: manuscript-facing logistic recovery with endpoint levels fixed from windows and tau_inc,t0_inc fit

transport_test.within_context_standardization: z score each of the four coordinates across the four shock strengths separately within each context
transport_test.geometry: Euclidean pairwise-distance vector among the four ordered shock strengths
transport_test.similarity: Spearman correlation between the six upper-triangle pairwise distances of reference and target context
transport_test.exact_test: enumerate all 24 permutations of target concentration labels; one-sided p is fraction with rho >= observed, including observed
transport_test.strong_transport: distance-geometry rho >= 0.8 AND exact p <= 0.10 AND A_dec concentration Spearman rho >= 0.8
transport_test.partial_transport: not strong, but distance-geometry rho >= 0.5 AND A_dec concentration Spearman rho >= 0.5

pooled_representation_test.standardization: z score each coordinate across all 16 rows
pooled_representation_test.one_dimensional_adequacy: PC1 variance fraction >= 0.95 AND maximum absolute standardized one-dimensional reconstruction residual <= 0.10

representation_hierarchy.Bio_Chi: transport or reorganization of the whole immediate motor collapse/recovery relation under context change
representation_hierarchy.Chi_bio: four-coordinate immediate response organization and its cross-context geometry
representation_hierarchy.chi_bio: NOT_OPENED_AT_FREEZE; fitted time constants remain empirical summaries, not mechanistic modal carriers

failure_rules: all source file blob identities and frozen trace counts must match
fit failures remain explicit and no trace is removed after result inspection
a source-written qualitative claim of similarity cannot rescue failed frozen geometry transport
clockwise-lock results are interpreted with the strain/plasmid background caveat
one-dimensional pooled compression, if adequate, still does not license chi_bio
claim_ceiling: same-source P0-Q transport qualification of immediate motor response organization; no independent biological replication, no universal biological chi law, and no isolated causal attribution for the clockwise-lock context
